full_judgment: 8. Leave was granted to consider the submission, first that the High Court Division had dismissed the suit upon misconception of the law as to undue influence, threat and coercion and decided the appeal without discussing the evidence on record and without traversing the findings of fact made by the trial Court and secondly, that the judgment of the High Court Division was not a proper judgment of reversal.
